items.title: Sarimelati Kencana Tbk PT By inc ransom
items.detail: PT Sarimelati Kencana Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Sriboga Raturaya and serves as the franchisee for YUM! International, holding the Pizza Hut brand for Indonesia. The company operates Pizza Hut restaurants and delivery services, catering to a wide range of customers seeking dining and takeaway options. Additionally, PT Sarimelati Kencana Tbk is involved in corporate social responsibility initiatives, contributing to humanitarian efforts in the community. Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.

items.detail: ISP / endpoint-surveillance services · Indonesia Full data leak: 2026-11-18 07:33 UTC This disclosure concerns a verified set of records from an organization in the ISP / endpoint-surveillance services sector. The material scheduled for publication comprises a set of business records, including personnel, financial, client, and operational material. items.title: Promantra, Inc. By metaencryptor
items.detail: ProMantra, Inc. is a US-based healthcare IT and business process outsourcing (BPO) company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Somerset, New Jersey. The company specializes in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical billing, medical coding, claims processing, and healthcare administrative services. It serves hospitals, physician groups, medical practices, and other healthcare organizations, primarily in the US, with operational delivery centers in India.
